page_title: STR 2-1 HAV | Strasbourg v Le Havre 10/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+6' 2 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header perfectly into the left side of the goal. He makes it 2:1.
90+6' Corner kick. Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) is ready to send the ball into the box.

90+6' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The ball is out of play. Strasbourg will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+4' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
90+3' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. Strasbourg force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+1' Strasbourg take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+1' Angelo (Strasbourg) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. Strasbourg have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90+1' Matz Sels displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

90' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
88' The referee allows time for a substitution. Mohamed Bayo will be replaced by Nabil Alioui (Le Havre).

87' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Christopher Operi (Le Havre), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
85' Dangerous play by Antoine Joujou (Le Havre). Benoit Millot blows his whistle for a foul.
82' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
82' The ball is cleared after Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee signals a corner kick to Le Havre.

81' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
78' Luka Elsner has decided to make a change. Andre Ayew (Le Havre) replaces Yassine Kechta.
78' Luka Elsner decides to make a substitution. Josue Casimir will be replaced by Loic Nego (Le Havre).
75' Here comes a substitution. Frederic Guilbert is given a rest as he is replaced by Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg).

75' The free kick from a promising distance is taken by Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre), who fires in a direct effort inches over the crossbar. What a chance! The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
73' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) was quite harsh and Benoit Millot didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

71' Matz Sels pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) fired on target from the rebound. His effort from inside the box was directed low to the middle of the goal.
71' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies onto the left post!
68' Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
66' Here is a change. Daler Kuzyaev is going off and Luka Elsner gives the last tactical orders to Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre).
66' A substitution has been made. Samuel Grandsir is replaced by Antoine Joujou (Le Havre).
65' That's the end of the game for Dilane Bakwa, who is replaced by Angelo (Strasbourg).
60' Substitution. Ibrahima Sissoko will be replaced by Habib Diarra (Strasbourg).
60' Patrick Vieira prepares a substitution. Moise Sahi Dion is replaced by Lebo Mothiba (Strasbourg).
60' Here's the change. Jessy Deminguet (Strasbourg) leaves the pitch and Kevin Gameiro comes on as a substitute.

58' Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) latches on to a brilliant through ball in a promising position, but one of the defenders is alert to the danger and dispossess him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
57' Jessy Deminguet (Strasbourg) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Benoit Millot stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
55' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
55' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates. The ball is out of play. Le Havre win a corner kick.
54' The corner from Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is hurriedly cleared.

53' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Strasbourg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
52' Good movement by Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
52' Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
49' 1 - 1 Yoann Salmier (Le Havre) wins the ball inside the box from the free kick and fires a superb strike into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
49' It seemed like Christopher Operi (Le Havre) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
49' A clumsy foul by Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) and Benoit Millot blows his whistle. Le Havre are awarded the free kick.
46' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Benoit Millot has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' The defensive wall stood firm and easily blocked the powerfully hit free kick from Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) on the edge of the box.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) is penalised for holding. Benoit Millot signals a set piece. Strasbourg are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
43' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 5:6.
40' Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
37' The free kick into the penalty area from Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) is cleared.
34' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is caught offside!
33' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
33' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
31' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) lashes the free kick from the edge of the box but it flies high over the bar, somewhere into the stands.
29' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) tackles a bit over-zealously and Benoit Millot blows for a foul. Le Havre have been awarded a free kick.
28' The free kick is taken by Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg), but ball is cleared.
27' What was Yoann Salmier (Le Havre) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
26' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
25' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
23' Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
21' 1 - 0 Spectacular goal! Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) brilliantly darts into the box to latch on to a cross and buries the ball into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper stunned!
21' Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) does well to connect with the resulting set piece, but his shot flies high over the crossbar.

20' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Benoit Millot blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.

18' A neat pass finds Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the bottom right corner, but Arthur Desmas denies him with a good save.
15' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by the players standing in the wall, saving the goalkeeper a lot of effort.
15' Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) trips an opposition player and Benoit Millot signals a foul. Strasbourg win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
12' Strasbourg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
11' This shall not pass! Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
9' Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
6' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Benoit Millot blows his whistle for an infringement.
5' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
4' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
1' The match has just started.
Strasbourg will kick the game off.
Benoit Millot is introduced as the referee for today's match.
